description: We are LynxLab from Liceo Los Cabos, we are a group of enthusiast teenagers trying to make some cool projects!
summary:
A local-hosted system that statistically evaluates real-time data from vital signs of astronauts in space missions to detect anomalies generates reports of them using an LLM.

Includes a local hosted dashboard to monitor all the data from the astronauts in the mission (to be used by mission control, or the astronaut itself) and checks for possible risks for the astronaut.
details:
The project consists of a system that registers in real-time the vital signs of astronauts in space missions for them to be monitored by mission control or the astronauts themselves.

The project includes a Llama local-hosted model that evaluates if an astronaut is in risk of suffering any complication based on their signs. It also generates reports for the medical staff of the mission for them to be more efficient with their time, being able to read an already existent diagnostic to know what to work at.

The previously recorded data and diagnostics are taken in account for future diagnostics and warning thresholds and stored in a database.

All this data and reports are shown into a dashboard which has all the relevant data indicators and warns for possible emergencies.

All of the project core is written in Python, exposing APIs that are read by the dashboard, mostly developed in a standard web-stack (HTML, CSS and Javascript).
